title: Mlo: An Intelligent School Feeding Management and Communication System

changedParagraphs.before: SMS Notification System: A Real-Time Communication System to Maintain Stakeholder Communication and Transparency in DISHI-OS
changedParagraphs.after: Mlo: An Intelligent School Feeding Management and Communication System

changedParagraphs.before: School feeding programs in Kenya face a persistent operational problem: the people responsible for running them parents, school administrators, suppliers, and county governments have no reliable way to communicate with each other in real time. When a meal goes unserved, a delivery goes unconfirmed, or a payment fails, the relevant parties often find out days later through manual reports, if at all. This communication gap drives financial leakage, erodes stakeholder trust, and slows the program's ability to respond to problems on the ground. This project develops an SMS Notification System as a dedicated module within the Digital School Feeding Management Platform (DSFMP), a broader digital operating system for school feeding programs built under the DISHI-OS initiative. The module is designed to bridge the communication gap by automatically sending targeted SMS alerts when key operational events occur including payment confirmations, daily meal delivery reports, low stock warnings, supplier delivery prompts, and non-reporting alerts for county administrators.
changedParagraphs.after: School feeding programs in Kenya face a persistent operational problem: the people responsible for running them parents, school administrators, suppliers, and county governments have no reliable way to communicate with each other in real time. When a meal goes unserved, a delivery goes unconfirmed, or a payment fails, the relevant parties often find out days later through manual reports, if at all. This communication gap drives financial leakage, erodes stakeholder trust, and slows the program's ability to respond to problems on the ground. This project develops Mlo, an intelligent school feeding management and communication system for schools, guardians, suppliers and county administrators. Mlo connects meal-service records, supplier dispatch and school receipt confirmation, historical demand forecasting, guardian SMS and USSD communication, and delivery reconciliation. Its intelligence combines explainable historical forecasting, configurable notification and exception rules, and advisory AI assessment of delivery photographs. Photo assessment supports human review and does not certify quantities or food safety.

changedParagraphs.before: The communication gap in Kenya's school feeding programs is not a minor operational inconvenience. It is a structural weakness. Financial leakage, supplier non-compliance, and slow administrative responses are, in large part, products of a system where nobody automatically knows when something has gone wrong. Embedding automated notifications into the DSFMP's operating layer changes that: it makes accountability a default rather than something that depends on someone remembering to follow up.

Embedding automated notifications into Mlo's operating layer changes that: it makes accountability a default rather than something that depends on someone remembering to follow up.

changedParagraphs.before: This project covers the design, development and testing of the SMS Notification System as a module within the DSFMP. It does not replace the payment, kitchen or procurement systems; it consumes their events. The system covers event capture at the point of service (NFC tap or staff override), a rules engine that drives notifications from seven trigger classes, guardian messaging over SMS and USSD, supplier dispatch declaration and school confirmation, reconciliation of portions dispatched against portions consumed, and role-scoped dashboards for schools, suppliers, county officers and administrators. All outbound messages and USSD sessions route through the Celcom Africa gateway.
changedParagraphs.after: This project covers the design, development and testing of Mlo, an intelligent school feeding management and communication system. It does not replace the payment, kitchen or procurement systems; it consumes their events. The system covers event capture at the point of service (NFC tap or staff override), a rules engine that drives notifications from seven trigger classes, guardian messaging over SMS and USSD, supplier dispatch declaration and school confirmation, reconciliation of portions dispatched against portions consumed, and role-scoped dashboards for schools, suppliers, county officers and administrators. All outbound messages and USSD sessions route through the Celcom Africa gateway.

changedParagraphs.before: The scope of this study is strictly delimited to public primary school feeding programs within Kenya operating under the DISHI-OS initiative. Consequently, private schools, community-based programs outside this ecosystem, or feeding initiatives in other East African countries are excluded. Furthermore, the evaluation of the platform's deployment will be confined to select administrative counties currently participating in the Digital School Feeding Management Platform (DSFMP) pilot, rather than a nationwide rollout assessment, to ensure manageable data collection and field testing.
changedParagraphs.after: The scope of this study is delimited to the school feeding management and communication workflows addressed by Mlo in the Nairobi County public primary school context. Private schools, community-based programmes outside the study context and feeding initiatives in other East African countries are excluded. The implementation and evaluation focus on the defined pilot and test scenarios rather than a nationwide rollout assessment.
